items.name: technical-grid
items.title: Animated Technical Grid
items.description: Hairline engineering grid with major lines, corner registration marks, a scanning line and pulsing intersection nodes. Reads as a calm blueprint with motion off.

props.description: A div that paints the grid behind its children. Extends every div prop.

props.name: tone
props.description: Line intensity and ink color. clay tints lines, scan line and nodes with the accent.

props.name: fade
props.description: Masks the field so the grid dissolves toward the edges or one side.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: Minor cell size in px. Clamped between 8 and 160.

props.name: majorEvery
props.description: Every Nth line is drawn stronger. 0 or 1 disables major lines.

props.name: scan
props.description: Direction of the sweeping scan line.

props.name: scanDuration
props.description: Seconds per sweep. Clamped between 1 and 60.

props.name: nodes
props.description: Count of pulsing intersection nodes, snapped to grid lines. Maximum 24.

props.name: markers
props.description: Draws registration marks in the four corners.

props.name: label
props.description: Mono caption pinned to the top left.

props.name: caption
props.description: Mono caption pinned to the bottom right.

props.name: animated
props.description: Turns the scan line and node pulses off while keeping the static grid.

variants.name: tone
variants.description: Foreground ink at 6 and 12 percent, 10 and 22 percent, or the clay accent.

variants.name: fade
variants.description: Radial or linear mask applied to the grid field only, never to children.

examples.title: Grid as a framed field
examples.description: Content sits above the grid in a relatively positioned wrapper.

examples.title: Grid as a section background
examples.description: Absolutely positioned behind content with an edge fade and both scan axes.

accessibility: The grid, scan line, nodes and corner marks are aria-hidden and ignore pointer events, so they never enter the accessibility tree or block clicks.
Nothing meaningful is encoded in the grid. label and caption are real text in text-muted-foreground, which stays above 4.5:1 on the card and background tokens.
Children render above the grid in normal DOM order and keep their own semantics and focus order.
With prefers-reduced-motion the scan line and node pulses are hidden. The static grid, nodes and marks remain, so the composition is complete with all motion off.

animation.properties: transform (translate) and opacity, composited on the GPU
animation.timing: scanDuration seconds, linear, infinite. Vertical scan starts half a cycle later so both axes never align.
animation.trigger: Starts on mount and loops without interaction.

animation.timing: 3 to 5 seconds per node, ease-out, infinite, delays staggered up to 4 seconds.
animation.trigger: Starts on mount and loops without interaction.
animation.reducedMotion: Ring hidden. The solid node dot stays.

items.name: agent-status-card
items.title: Agent Status Card
items.description: Status card for an agent run with a designation, role, live status, task line, segmented progress and mono metadata. Status is always text, never color alone.

props.description: An article with a header, a body and optional metadata and footer. Extends every article prop except title.

props.name: agentId
props.description: Designation shown above the name, for example AG-03.

props.name: name
props.description: Role or agent name. Labels the article and truncates when long.

props.name: task
props.description: One line describing what the agent is doing.

props.name: status
props.description: Drives the tone color, the status dot and the default status label.

props.name: statusLabel
props.description: Overrides the default status text, for localisation or a more specific phrase.

props.name: progress
props.description: 0 to 100. Renders the segmented progress bar. Omit to hide it.

props.name: meta
props.description: Mono key and value pairs rendered as equal columns under the body.

props.name: footer
props.description: Slot under a hairline for actions such as approve or inspect.

props.name: announce
props.description: Makes the status text a polite live region so screen readers hear status changes.

props.name: children
props.description: Extra content rendered in the body under the progress bar.

variants.name: status
variants.description: idle is muted, running is clay, review is steel, blocked is destructive and done is moss. The same tone paints the top hairline, the cube, the dot and the filled progress segments.

examples.title: Running agent
examples.description: Progress, metadata and a live status announcement.

examples.title: Awaiting a human decision
examples.description: The review status with an action footer. The agent proposes, a person decides.

accessibility: Renders an article labelled by the name heading, so each card is a named landmark-like region in the reading order.
Status is always written out as text. The dot and tone color are redundant cues, never the only one.
Progress uses role progressbar with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and a readable aria-valuetext.
Set announce on cards whose status changes live. It turns the status text into a polite status region. It is off by default to avoid noisy pages.
Tone colors keep at least 4.5:1 against the card in both themes. The cube and dot are aria-hidden.

animation.properties: transform (scale) and opacity, a ping ring behind the dot
animation.reducedMotion: Ring removed with motion-safe. The solid dot stays.

animation.trigger: The first unfilled segment while status is running.

items.name: magnetic-button
items.title: Industrial Magnetic Button
items.description: Hairline button that leans toward the pointer, sweeps a clay fill in from the left and extends corner marks on hover. Ships as a button and as a link.

props.description: A native button. Extends every button prop except children, which is required.

props.name: variant
props.description: Surface treatment. Every variant except ghost fills with clay on hover.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual height of 36, 44 or 56 px. The touch target is at least 44 px for every size.

props.name: strength
props.description: Maximum pull toward the pointer in px. Clamped between 0 and 24. 0 turns the magnet off.

props.name: index
props.description: Optional mono index shown before the label, for example 01. Decorative and hidden from assistive tech.

props.name: type
props.description: Native button type. Defaults to button so it never submits a form by accident.
The same surface as a native anchor. Extends every anchor prop except children, which is required.

props.name: href
props.description: Destination. Every other prop matches MagneticButton.

variants.name: variant
variants.description: outline is a hairline, solid is a filled foreground, accent is clay text and border, ghost has no border and fills with the accent surface.

variants.name: size
variants.description: Height, horizontal padding and label size.

examples.title: Variants and sizes
examples.description: All four variants side by side with a disabled state.

examples.title: Link with an index
examples.description: A call to action rendered as an anchor.

accessibility: Renders a native button or anchor, so keyboard activation, focus order, disabled handling and the accessible name come from the platform.
The interactive element is at least 44 by 44 px for every size. Smaller visual sizes pad the hit area without changing how the button looks.
Hover effects are pointer-only through Tailwind's hover media query and are mirrored on focus-visible, so keyboard users get the same fill, color and corner marks.
Focus uses a 2 px ring with an offset that follows the visible surface, not the larger hit area.
The label contrast holds at 4.5:1 or more on the clay fill in both themes.
Only mouse and pen pointers pull the button. Touch never moves it.

animation.properties: translate on the surface. Label translates a further 50 percent for depth.
animation.timing: 100 ms while the pointer moves, 500 ms release, both on ease-out-expo. Pull is 30 percent of the offset from the center, clamped to strength.
animation.trigger: Pointer move over the button. Values are written as CSS variables, so React never re-renders per frame.
animation.reducedMotion: No magnet and no label shift.
Transitions are removed. The fill appears instantly.

animation.properties: opacity and translate on the marks. scale 0.97 on press.
animation.trigger: Hover and focus-visible for the marks. Pointer down for the press.

items.name: text-scramble
items.title: Text Scramble Reveal
items.description: Monospace text that resolves out of noise glyphs, left to right. The real text is always in the DOM, and reduced motion renders it plain.

props.description: An inline-grid element that animates its text. Extends every span prop except children.

props.name: text
props.description: The final text. Always rendered in the DOM for assistive tech, search and copy.

props.name: trigger
props.description: When the scramble runs. visible waits until half of the text is on screen. manual runs when replayKey changes.

props.name: duration
props.description: Milliseconds until the last glyph resolves.

props.name: charset
props.description: Preset noise alphabet.

props.name: characters
props.description: Custom noise alphabet. Overrides charset.

props.name: once
props.description: With the visible trigger, stop observing after the first reveal.

props.name: replayKey
props.description: Change it to replay the animation, for example from a button.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render, so headings keep their semantics.

props.name: variant
props.description: Type treatment. All three are monospace so glyph swaps never change the layout.

props.name: tone
props.description: Resolved text color. Unresolved glyphs use clay, or the foreground color when the tone is accent.

variants.name: variant
variants.description: label is 12 px uppercase and tracked, heading is 24 px medium, body is 14 px.

variants.name: tone
variants.description: Foreground, muted foreground or clay for the resolved text.

examples.title: Heading revealed on scroll
examples.description: The default visible trigger on a real h2.

examples.title: Hover and manual replay
examples.description: A hex label that rescrambles on hover and a button that replays a heading.

accessibility: The final text is always present as the element's real content, so screen readers, find in page, translation tools and copy all see it. The animated copy is aria-hidden.
Both copies share one grid cell. The final copy reserves the box, so the scramble never shifts the layout.
With prefers-reduced-motion no scramble runs for any trigger and the final text is shown immediately.
No JavaScript renders the final text statically from the server.
Use as to render real headings. The animated copy never changes the heading level or the reading order.

animation.properties: text content of one span per glyph. No layout or style properties are animated.
animation.timing: One requestAnimationFrame loop. Noise glyphs reshuffle every 45 ms. 70 percent of the duration is a left to right stagger and 30 percent is random jitter.
animation.trigger: mount, first time half of the text is visible, pointer enter or focus, or replayKey change.
animation.reducedMotion: Skipped. Final text is shown immediately.

animation.timing: Switches the instant a glyph resolves.

items.name: blueprint-panel
items.title: Blueprint Panel
items.description: Hairline panel with registration marks outside the corners, a mono header with an index and meta slot, and a footer. A calm frame for anything that should read as a drawing sheet.

props.description: The frame. A section that extends every section prop.

props.name: tone
props.description: default and clay sit on the card surface, inset sits on a recessed muted surface. clay tints the corner marks.

props.name: markers
props.description: Draws registration marks outside the four corners.
A 40 px mono header row with a bottom hairline.

props.name: index
props.description: Muted index before the title, for example 02 or SH-01.

props.name: meta
props.description: Right aligned muted content such as a revision.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading element used for the title.
Padded body that grows to fill the panel. Extends every div prop.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged with the base padding, so p-0 or a grid layout can replace it.
Mono footer row with a top hairline. Extends every footer prop.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged with the base layout.

examples.title: Spec sheet
examples.description: Header with index and revision, a definition list and a footer.

accessibility: Renders a section. Give it aria-label or aria-labelledby when the header title should name it.
The header title is a real heading and headingLevel keeps the document outline correct.
Registration marks are aria-hidden and ignore pointer events.
Header and footer text use foreground and muted foreground tokens, which stay above 4.5:1 on the card surface.
